component.name: acvram
component.summary: Local LLM inference server for NVIDIA GPUs, OpenAI-compatible
Serveur d'inférence LLM local pour GPU NVIDIA, compatible OpenAI

description.p: acvram serves large language models on a single NVIDIA GPU through an OpenAI-compatible HTTP API (/v1/chat/completions, /v1/completions). It treats memory as a hierarchy (VRAM, host RAM), gives every layer the numeric format its silicon reads best (NVFP4 experts, int8 projections, int8 KV cache) and measures its own throughput and energy per token.

ul.li: Native console window: start and stop the server, pick a model, watch GPUs, sensors and temperatures
Mixture-of-experts models (Qwen3-Coder, GLM, Kimi) and dense models, NVFP4 and int8 formats
CUDA graphs, paged attention, prefix cache, speculative decoding
Requires an NVIDIA GPU with a recent driver (Blackwell RTX 50 recommended; Ada and Ampere with precompiled kernels)

description.p: Models are read from the user's folders (read-only). The NVIDIA driver is provided by the org.freedesktop.Platform.GL.nvidia extension; CUDA libraries are bundled.

acvram sert des grands modèles de langage sur un GPU NVIDIA par une API HTTP compatible OpenAI. Il traite la mémoire comme une hiérarchie (VRAM, RAM), donne à chaque étage le format numérique que son silicium sait le mieux lire (experts NVFP4, projections int8, cache KV int8) et mesure son débit et son énergie par jeton.

screenshot.caption: Throughput and energy against vLLM and llama.cpp

description.p: acvram doctor no longer exits 1 (NameError in the eco section); optional extras (vision: transformers, pillow) reported as a warning, not a failure; the Flatpak ships the vision extra.

/metrics served off the HTTP event loop (TTFT at 12 requests under a 20 Hz metrics reader 0.78 → 0.24 s); chat template and tokenizer off the loop; FP8-origin int8 prefill on demand (ACVRAM_I8C_FP8_PREFILL=cublas), signed copy by xor by default.

Marlin MoE by expert row on demand (ACVRAM_MARLIN_PAR_LIGNE=1 ; default 0 for the release), int8 narrow projections per channel, GDN alpha/beta on a second stream, admission window, KV margins for recurrent models, TTFT tool, logprobs and usage in the OpenAI API.
Experts on tensor cores by default (w13), MAX_GRAPHS 64, unrolled attention reduction.
